name: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.)
eligibility: 10+2 (Intermediate) or equivalent examination from a recognized board in any stream (Arts, Science, Commerce).
feeSummary: [PLACEHOLDER: As prescribed by DBRAU Agra and State Fee Regulatory Committee]
description: Comprehensive degree curriculum designed to develop critical thinking, communication skills, and in-depth cultural, historical, and socio-economic perspectives.

name: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.)
eligibility: 10+2 (Intermediate) with Science stream (Mathematics or Biology group) with minimum qualifying marks from recognized board.
feeSummary: [PLACEHOLDER: As prescribed by DBRAU Agra and State Fee Regulatory Committee]
description: Hands-on scientific education with practical laboratory training, empirical investigation methods, and rigorous theoretical foundations in natural and physical sciences.

name: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.)
eligibility: 10+2 (Intermediate) with Commerce or Science/Arts with Mathematics from a recognized education board.
feeSummary: [PLACEHOLDER: As prescribed by DBRAU Agra and State Fee Regulatory Committee]
description: Professional commerce education focusing on financial reporting, taxation, commercial legislation, trade, banking operations, and corporate management.
